name: Wikipedia in other languages
description: Wikipedia in widely spoken languages other than English, in the smallest edition the Kiwix library offers for each, so that Explore can suggest the encyclopedia in the language of the country Home is in. Every entry is fetched from Kiwix's own servers at the moment you ask for it; nothing is bundled with Outpost.

entries.name: Wikipedia in French (introductions only, without images)
entries.description: All of the French Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. This is the smallest edition: only the introduction of each article, without images.
entries.attribution: Wikipedia contributors. Packaged as a ZIM archive by the Kiwix project.
